newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread up as results beat expectations.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread up as results beat expectations.

text.p: Shares in Whitbread Plc rose in early trading on Tuesday after the brewing-to-hotels group posted a 14 percent rise in first-half pre-tax profit to 177.5 million stg, at the top end of the range of analyst forecasts.
The stock was up 7p at 747-1/2 by 0805 GMT.
The rise pushed the shares to their highest level since the middle of May.

Whitbread chairman Sir Michael Angus said like-for-like sales growth was five percent, which he said was a strong trading performance, though profits were flattered by a reduced pensions contribution.

"We expect the recent levels of growth in our major markets to continue," he said. "Our trading results for the first six months confirm that consumer spending is on an upward path and I expect this to continue."
